units.source_text: 假如这是音波的话，究竟能听到怎样的音乐呢？

en.t: If these were sound waves, what kind of music could one possibly hear?

units.source_text: 假如往鼻孔里钉入火钳，那黏乎乎的血便塞住了耳朵，

en.t: If fire tongs were driven into the nostrils, and the sticky blood stopped up the ears,

units.source_text: 用槌子敲碎一个个牙齿，把那些碎片塞入尿道之中，

en.t: if each tooth were smashed with a hammer and the fragments stuffed into the urethra,

units.source_text: 割下阴唇，把上下眼皮缝合起来的话，人们也许也能唱出那样的歌吧……

en.t: if the labia were cut away and the upper and lower eyelids sewn together, perhaps people too could sing such a song...

units.source_text: 和残酷很相似，又和残酷有所不同……

en.t: It was very much like cruelty, and yet somehow different from cruelty...

units.source_text: 他觉得自己的眼珠像鸟儿般高高地飞起，往下紧盯着自己看。

en.t: He felt as if his own eyeballs had flown high up like birds and were staring fixedly down at him.

units.source_text: 在这种地方，有着古怪想法的自己，才是最古怪的存在吧。

en.t: In a place like this, perhaps he himself, with his strange thoughts, was the strangest thing of all.
